events.injected_text: Report cohort size in hundreds of samples.
Express the fraction value itself as a percent.

human_repair_overrides.content: \nIdentify the Affected BLM cohort used as BSyn Probands and report its size in hundreds of samples.
Convert each VAF to percentage points, round it to the nearest whole percent, and retain rows with rounded VAF strictly below 30%.
Divide the exact-Benign count by the resulting qualifying-row count, then append a percent sign to that raw fraction without multiplying by 100.
